title: Work component of restricted-weight cost
statement: For a restricted-weight input with positive dimension $n$, positive accuracy numerator $a$, $2a$ at most its accuracy denominator, and Fourier bound $s \ge 1$, and for any finite set $S$, the work component of its deterministic restricted-weight cost is the sum of its construction work, query count, and local work for $S$.
hypotheses_covered: Twice the accuracy numerator is at most the accuracy denominator
Fourier bound is at least one
